See paragraphs 11.1, 11.15 and 11.18 to 11.20.

9. If the appropriate adult is present at an interview, they shall be informed they are not expected
to act simply as an observer and the purposes of their presence are to:
• advise the interviewee;
• observe whether or not the interview is being conducted properly and fairly;
• facilitate communication with the interviewee.
See paragraph 11.17

10. If the detention of a vulnerable person is reviewed by a review officer or a superintendent, the
appropriate adult must, if available at the time, be given an opportunity to make
representations to the officer about the need for continuing detention. See paragraph 15.3.
